newsitem.title: CHINA: HK 182-DAY BILLS AVERAGE ACCEPTED YIELD 6.49 PCT.
newsitem.headline: HK 182-DAY BILLS AVERAGE ACCEPTED YIELD 6.49 PCT.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 182-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 6.49 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said.
That compares with six-month HIBOR of 6.92308 percent at 0300 GMT. Bids for the HK$1 billion issue stood at HK$4.04 billion.
The average accepted yield of 91-day Exchange Fund bills was 6.47 percent, versus three-month HIBOR of 6.88462 percent.
Bids for the HK$2 billion issue totalled HK$6.62 billion.
The average accepted yield of 28-day Exchange Fund bills was 6.50 percent, compared with one-month HIBOR of 6.84135 percent.
Bids for the HK$5 billion issue amounted to HK$13.21 billion, the HKMA said.
